en.title: New Jersey declares state of emergency ahead of Thanksgiving storm, Macy's parade postponed
en.dek: Governor Sherrill acts as powerful nor'easter approaches for holiday weekend
facts: Governor Mikie Sherrill declared a state of emergency on Wednesday ahead of a powerful Thanksgiving nor'easter
Macy's announced the Thanksgiving Day Parade is being postponed to Saturday due to severe weather
The parade postponement marks the first time in the event's history
Army conducted a controlled munitions detonation in Iowa early Wednesday
Severe weather includes potential hurricane-force wind gusts for Thanksgiving
body: Governor Mikie Sherrill declared a state of emergency on Wednesday ahead of a powerful Thanksgiving nor'easter, according to The Jersey Vindicator and CBS News.
Macy's announced on Wednesday that the annual Thanksgiving Day Parade is being postponed to Saturday due to severe weather, according to Axios and CNBC, marking the first time in the event's history.
The postponement comes as severe weather approaches the region for the holiday weekend, with FOX 5 New York reporting potential hurricane-force wind gusts for Thanksgiving.
Army conducted a controlled munitions detonation in Iowa early Wednesday despite initial public health fears that had pushed back the plans, according to verified updates.
The state of emergency was issued as the powerful nor'easter approaches the region, with Governor Sherrill taking action ahead of the Thanksgiving holiday.
Retailers and media reports confirmed the Macy's parade postponement, noting the decision was made due to the severe weather conditions.
en.context: Governor Mikie Sherrill declared a state of emergency ahead of a powerful Thanksgiving nor'easter, and Macy's announced the Thanksgiving Day Parade postponement for the first time in its history due to severe weather.

en.headline: Army conducts controlled munitions detonation in Iowa
en.body: Army detonated a degraded stockpile of lead-based munitions in Iowa early Wednesday. The controlled explosion proceeded despite initial public health fears that had pushed back the plans.

es.headline: El Ejército realiza una detonación controlada de municiones en Iowa
es.body: El Ejército detonó un stockpile degradado de municiones con base de plomo en Iowa el miércoles temprano. La explosión controlada se procedió a pesar de los temores iniciales de salud pública que habían retrasado los planes.

it.headline: Esercito conduce detonazione controllata di munizioni in Iowa
it.body: L'Esercito ha detonato un lotto di munizioni a base di piombo deteriorato in Iowa nella prima mattinata di mercoledì. L'esplosione controllata ha avuto luogo nonostante le iniziali preoccupazioni per la salute pubblica che avevano ritardato i piani.

de.headline: Armee führt kontrollierte Sprengstoffdetonation in Iowa durch
de.body: Die Armee hat am frühen Mittwoch ein veraltetes Lagerbestand an bleihaltigen Sprengstoffen in Iowa gesprengt. Die kontrollierte Explosion fand trotz anfänglicher öffentlicher Gesundheitsbedenken statt, die die Pläne zunächst verzögert hatten.

pt.headline: Exército realiza detonação controlada de munições em Iowa
pt.body: Exército detonou um stockpile degradado de munições de chumbo em Iowa na quarta-feira cedo. A explosão controlada prosseguiu apesar dos medos iniciais de saúde pública que tinham adiado os planos.

ja.headline: アーミー、アイオワ州で管理下の爆発処分
ja.body: アーミーは水曜早朝、鉛ベースの劣化弾薬の在庫をアイオワ州で管理下の爆発処分した。当初、公衆衛生上の懸念が計画を遅らせていたが、管理下の爆発は行われた。

zh.headline: 军队在爱荷华州进行受控弹药爆炸
zh.body: 军队周三早些时候在爱荷华州引爆了降级的铅基弹药库存。尽管最初有公共卫生方面的担忧推迟了计划，但这次受控爆炸还是进行了。

ko.headline: 아미, 아이오와주에서 통제된 탄약 폭발 실시
ko.body: 아미가 수요일 이른 시간 아이오와주에서 분해된 납 기반 탄약을 통제된 폭발로 처리했다. 초기 공중보건 우려로 계획이 미뤄졌으나 폭발은 강행됐다.

fr.headline: L'armée américaine effectue une détonation contrôlée de munitions en Iowa
fr.body: L'armée américaine a procédé à la détonation contrôlée d'un stock de munitions à base de plomb en Iowa, mercredi matin. L'explosion s'est déroulée malgré des craintes initiales de santé publique qui avaient retardé les plans.

de.body: Gouverneurin Mikie Sherrill hat am Mittwoch angesichts eines heftigen Nor'easter-Sturms zum Thanksgiving-Fest den Notstand ausgerufen. Die Ausrufung des Notstands erfolgte im Zuge des Herannahens von Unwettern in der Region für das Feiertagswochenende.
de.headline: New Jersey ruft vor Thanksgiving-Sturm den Notstand aus

en.body: Governor Mikie Sherrill declared a state of emergency on Wednesday ahead of a powerful Thanksgiving nor'easter. The state of emergency was issued as severe weather approaches the region for the holiday weekend.
en.headline: New Jersey declares state of emergency ahead of Thanksgiving storm

es.body: La gobernadora Mikie Sherrill declaró el estado de emergencia este miércoles ante una potente tormenta del noreste prevista para Acción de Gracias. El estado de emergencia se emitió a medida que se acerca tiempo severo a la región para el fin de semana festivo.

fr.body: La gouverneure Mikie Sherrill a déclaré l'état d'urgence mercredi, en prévision d'une puissante tempête hivernale (« nor'easter ») pour Thanksgiving. Cette mesure a été prise alors que des conditions météorologiques sévères menacent la région pour le week-end férié.
fr.headline: Le New Jersey déclare l'état d'urgence avant une tempête pour Thanksgiving

it.body: La governatrice Mikie Sherrill ha dichiarato mercoledì lo stato di emergenza in vista di un potente nor'easter previsto per il Ringraziamento. Lo stato di emergenza è stato emanato a causa dell'avvicinarsi di condizioni meteorologiche avverse nella regione per il fine settimana festivo.

ja.body: ミッキー・シェリル知事は水曜日、感謝祭を直撃する強力な北東の嵐（ノーイースター）に備え、非常事態を宣言した。ホリデーシーズンに向けて悪天候が同地域に接近していることを受け、非常事態宣言が出された。

de.body: Macy's hat am Mittwoch angekündigt, dass die jährliche Thanksgiving Day Parade wegen schweren Unwetters auf Samstag verschoben wird. Einzelhändler und Medienberichte bestätigten, dass die Veranstaltung zum ersten Mal in ihrer Geschichte verschoben wurde.

en.body: Macy's announced on Wednesday that the annual Thanksgiving Day Parade is being postponed to Saturday due to severe weather. Retailers and media reports confirmed that the event has been postponed for the first time in its history.

es.body: Macy's anunció este miércoles que el tradicional desfile de Acción de Gracias se aplaza al sábado debido a las condiciones meteorológicas adversas. Minoristas e informes de prensa confirmaron que el evento se ha pospuesto por primera vez en su historia.

fr.body: Macy's a annoncé mercredi que la parade annuelle de Thanksgiving est reportée à samedi en raison de conditions météorologiques sévères. Des détaillants et des rapports médiatiques ont confirmé qu'il s'agit du premier report de l'événement dans son histoire.

it.body: Macy's ha annunciato mercoledì che l'annuale parata del Ringraziamento è stata rinviata a sabato a causa del maltempo. I rivenditori e i resoconti dei media hanno confermato che l'evento è stato posticipato per la prima volta nella sua storia.

ja.body: メイシーズは水曜日、毎年恒例の感謝祭パレードを悪天候のため土曜日に延期すると発表した。小売業者やメディアの報道によると、同イベントが延期されるのは史上初となる。
